title: VISOR: A Vision-Language Selector for Multimodal Time-Series Forecasting
abstract: arXiv:2611.31780v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Recent time-series foundation models (TSFMs) forecast a distribution over futures, and multimodal time-series (TS) forecasting further exploits other modalities to improve forecasting accuracy. However, existing works have two limitations: 1) TSFMs reduce the predictive distribution to its median or mean, flattening diverse futures into a calm line, and 2) multimodal TS forecasting models incorporate text into the forecaster through TS-language alignment, which is substantially weaker than vision-language alignment. To address these limitations, we propose the VIsion-language SelectOR (VISOR), a multimodal TS forecasting framework that selects one plausible future instead of averaging across candidates, leveraging the alignment capabilities of vision-language models (VLMs) to select the most suitable candidate based on textual information. translated_title: VISOR：用于多模态时间序列预测的视觉-语言选择器
translated_abstract: 近期的时间序列基础模型（TSFMs）会对未来进行分布预测，而多模态时间序列（TS）预测则进一步利用其他模态来提高预测精度。然而，现有工作存在两个局限性：1）TSFMs 将预测分布简化为其中位数或均值，把多样化的未来扁平成一条平缓的曲线；2）多模态 TS 预测模型通过时间序列-语言对齐将文本信息融入预测器，而这种对齐能力远弱于视觉-语言对齐。为了解决这些局限性，我们提出了视觉-语言选择器（VISOR），这是一个多模态时间序列预测框架，它不再对候选未来取平均，而是选择出一个合理的未来，利用视觉-语言模型（VLMs）的对齐能力，根据文本信息挑选出最合适的候选。VISOR 由两个组件构成：1）一个无文本的随机预测器，用于采样多样化的候选……
tldr: VISOR 提出利用视觉-语言模型的强对齐能力，根据文本信息从随机预测器生成的多个候选未来中选出最合理的一个，而非取平均，从而改进多模态时间序列预测。
en_tdlr: VISOR leverages the strong alignment capabilities of vision-language models to select the most plausible future from diverse candidates generated by a stochastic predictor based on textual information, instead of averaging them, thereby improving multimodal time-series forecasting.
